data.long_meaning: One who travels for trade or commerce. The name Saafir carries the meaning “Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Saafir usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey of self-discovery and personal growth
data.etymology: Saafir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saafir total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: صافِر
in_arabic.long_meaning: الصافِر: المرتبة العالية ، المستقر الذي لا يهاب ، الخالي من العوائق و العادات السيئة. يُشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بالسماحة والمرونة ، ويستطيع الوصول إلى الأفضل في كل شيء. يُعتبر اسمًا مشروعًا في الإسلام ، حيث يرمز إلى الصفات الجيدة والعلاقات البنّاءة. يُستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف الشخصية العالية ، حيث يقول الله تعالى: (وَكَذَلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِنْ حَقٍّ) [النجم: 4].

in_urdu.name: صافِر
in_urdu.long_meaning: صافِر ایک بلند مرتبہ اور مستقر شخص ہوتا ہے ، جو عادات کی عوارض سے پاک ہو۔ یہ ایک مشروع نام ہے جس سے عالمی شہرت حاصل ہوئی ہے۔ اس کا تعلق اسلام کے مشتقات سے ہے ، جس کا ذکر قرآن میں بھی ملتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: साफिर
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च दर्जा, स्थिर, बाधाओं से मुक्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: साफिर एक उच्च-दर्जा का व्यक्ति होता है जो स्थिर और बाधाओं से मुक्त होता है। यह एक पारंपरिक नाम है जिसका उपयोग भारतीय मुसलमानों द्वारा किया जाता है। इसका अर्थ है शुद्ध, निर्मल और स्वच्छ व्यक्तित्व।

in_pashto.name: صافِر
in_pashto.long_meaning: صافِر د ځان ډير لوړو ځاي ته لېږي، د هغو د ځان په څرګندولو کې د تکبېرو په ګاڼو نيسي، د هغه د ځان د لويو ځاي ته د لوړو کړو په ګاڼو نيسي. دا نوم د افغانستان اوپښتونو خلکو لپاره د يو ځانګړو ځانګړتياوو په ګاڼو نيسي.

in_english.name: Saafir
in_english.long_meaning: Saafir is a name that refers to a person of high stature, stability, and freedom from obstacles. It is a commendable name in Islam, symbolizing good qualities and good relationships. The name is mentioned in the Quran, and its origin is from the Arabic root 'safara', which means to be high or elevated. In Islamic tradition, Saafir is considered a name that represents the qualities of a pious and righteous person.

data.cultural_impact: The name Saafir holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world, particularly among Arab and Middle Eastern communities. Saafir translates to "traveler" or "trade merchant" in Arabic. Historically, the Islamic world was a major center for trade and commerce, with the Silk Road connecting the East to the West. The name Saafir reflects this rich tradition of trade and commerce, which played a crucial role in connecting different civilizations and fostering cultural exchange. Saafir is also a name of respect and admiration, as trade and commerce require courage, determination, and entrepreneurship.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Saafir holds several meanings. It is believed that traveling or undertaking a journey is a metaphor for the spiritual journey of life. Thus, the name Saafir can be seen as a reminder of the importance of being on a continuous spiritual quest. Additionally, as the Islamic tradition emphasizes the importance of economic and material prosperity, the name Saafir can be seen as a reminder that worldly success is not an end in itself, but a means to achieve higher spiritual goals. The success and progress represented by the name Saafir should be used to benefit oneself and others, and to seek closeness to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Traveler" symbolizes One who travels for trade or commerce. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Saafir serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of traveler.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Saafir ibn al-Mu'attal was a famous poet in the 10th century. The name Saafir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Saafir ibn al-Mu'attal was a famous Arabic poet during the Abbasid Caliphate.
